_about: Task 25.3 (Req 40.7): distinctive proper nouns and coined system terms of existing open-world action RPGs (element and reaction names, places, characters, monsters, system items), in English and in their official Korean localization. tests/unit/originality.test.ts fails when any string literal or data value of src/ contains one: Latin entries as whole words (case-insensitive, camelCase / snake_case split), Korean entries as a whole space-separated word (optionally followed by a particle). Everyday words those games also use as names are deliberately left out because they are not the games' own inventions and this game uses them in their plain sense (aether, amber, echo, guardian, shrine, slime, swirl, spread, talus, vision, waypoint, 확산, 증발); a few technical terms that serve as those games' reaction or item names are kept (Superconduct, Overloaded, 감전, 원석) because this game never needs them. Multi-word phrases are listed when the phrase itself is the game's term (e.g. 'Stone Talus', 'Statue of the Seven').
